levelRule: Level-based games need at least 20 authored levels with level select through env.progress.

records.hashCheck: The reviewer recorded the hashes at the start and the end of the final rounds. Two rounds were voided because the owner edited files mid-review; the final set was re-verified after each change.

findings.observation: Early boards had 3-6 live tiles, so an informed random turner solved boards 3-8 52-100% of the time, and a port-pair hill-climber solved 19 of 24 boards including 17-20. Boards were regenerated: boards 3-8 have 8-13 live turnable tiles, 15 boards carry budgets, and late boards resist greedy play. Informed random and mash now win at most 10% per board from board 3, port-pair greedy wins at least half the runs only on boards 1-9 and 12, and none of 17-24 above 12%.

A hill-climber that tries a turn and undoes it when the score drops solved board 20 99 of 100 times and board 17 56%, because undo refunds the budget. Boards 17, 20, 21 and 22 were regenerated against it; it now wins at most 13% on boards 17-24.
Shorts were essentially unreachable, so the voltage-separation rule never bit. Open boards 6, 7, 11, 14, 15 and 16 now short after one natural wrong turn; sealed late boards need two.
The hint re-solved on every cursor move and took up to 331 ms on board 15. The solver now prunes unreachable lamps and caches by tile arrangement; worst in-play latency is under 2 ms.

176 of 269 move prompts named an ambiguous landmark; they now fall back to row and column (0 ambiguous). Board tips were never shown and now appear for the first 6 s. The prompt was missing from the host status line and is now its last segment.

Stale short flag after undo, unbounded undo stack, a second wiring on board 9, Infinity progress, mutable exported data, open-board wirings that exceeded the budget, and a 1313-line file (now four modules) were all fixed.

openNotes: For up to 6 s at each board start the narrow host status line shows the banner and tip, and the prompt is clipped by the shared ellipsis style; the prompt stays on the canvas and in the DOM text.
Undo refunds the turn budget; late boards resist free probing by design, earlier boards do not.
Port-pair greedy solves boards 1-9 every time; they are accepted as tutorial and combination boards.
Shorts on sealed late boards need two wrong turns and are rare (0.002-0.76% of random states).
